sentences.Hei Pablo. Lenge siden sist!: Hi Pablo. Long time no see!
sentences.Ja, det er det. Vet du hva jeg har gjort: Yes, it has been. Do you know what I've been doing?
sentences.Nei, jeg har vært på hvalsafari i Nord-N: No, I've been on a whale safari in Northern Norway, at a place called Andenes.
sentences.Ja, tre store spermhvaler. Det var helt: Yes, three big sperm whales. It was absolutely fantastic. I went out by boat.
sentences.Mm - nei, sammen med kona mi og 80 andre: Mm - no, with my wife and 80 other people.
Everyone was taking pictures and shouting "whale, whale".
sentences.Har du sett spermhval noen gang? Den er: Have you ever seen a sperm whale? It's enormous.
sentences.Jeg har bare sett den på tv. Men nordmen: I've only seen it on TV. But Norwegians eat whale meat, don't they?
Yes. That's typically Norwegian, I think.
sentences.Har du lyst til å treffe «skogens konge»: Would you like to meet "the king of the forest"?
Then come with us on a moose safari.
sentences.Fra midten av juni til slutten av august: From the middle of June to the end of August we drive into the forest by minibus.
sentences.Vi starter om kvelden når det begynner å: We set off in the evening when it starts getting dark, because then the chances of meeting a moose are high.
sentences.Vi kjenner området godt, og vi kan love: We know the area well, and we can promise you an exciting experience.
sentences.For mer informasjon og bestilling, ring: For more information and booking, call Kristoffer on 124 40 315.
sentences.Vil du vite hvordan det er på Svalbard?: Do you want to know what it's like in Svalbard?
sentences.Vil du se om isbjørnen går rundt i gaten: Do you want to see if polar bears walk around the streets in the middle of the day?
sentences.Bli med oss på scootertur om vinteren el: Join us on a snowmobile trip in winter or a boat trip in summer.
sentences.Her vil du oppleve en vakker og vill nat: Here you will experience beautiful, wild nature, and perhaps you'll also meet "the king of the Arctic".
